title: JUG GIS Cities Input Dataset Manifest
description: Flexible reference to one source dataset used by a municipality-specific GIS cleaning workflow. The dataset content is referenced by path or URI and is not embedded.

role.description: Workflow role played by this source dataset.

path_or_uri.description: Local/container path, cloud URI, or HTTP(S) URL where the dataset can be read.

format.description: Declared dataset format or container type.

layer_name.description: Optional layer name for container formats such as GeoPackage.

declared_crs.description: Expected or declared CRS identifier, for example EPSG:4326.

field_mappings.description: Optional workflow-specific semantic field mappings. Keys are semantic field names, values are source dataset field names.

municipality.description: Optional municipality identifier if the dataset is shared across manifests.

workflow_identifier.description: Optional workflow or component identifier associated with this dataset.

metadata.description: Optional source metadata, including large raster or LiDAR hints.
